plan.title: Reverse Auction Auto Title by Location

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction using the reverse-auction configuration.
Apply the first offered auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product with quantity 10 while leaving its delivery location unset.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify the title remains empty before a delivery location is selected.
Select Plant Name for the first line item's delivery location.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [Reverse Auction] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name
